title: NillOne
description: Custom Textures - Unique Game Modes - Open ALPHA
body:
Nill Lag, One Network! 🚀

Welcome to Nill.One NETWORK – a next-gen server with custom textures, unique gamemodes, and powerful in-game own server hosting. EU based.

⚡ Premium Private Servers
Create your own Minecraft server in ~60 seconds directly in-game.
Host events, play with friends, or build your own worlds – all inside the same network.

🌍 ChainRaidz (Semi-Hardcore SMP)
An MMO-style survival experience on a 10k × 10k seasonal map featuring:
• Custom bosses & epic fights
• Rust-style: Land claims & raiding
• PvP and PvE progression
• Unique items and mechanics
• Seasonal custom gen resets to keep the world fresh

🚀 SpaceWarped (MiniGame)
A fast-paced attacker vs defender game.
Steal or protect the valuable gem — go loud or stay stealthy. Similar to TTT.

👾 MobRush (Coming Soon)
Create your own adventure: design challenges using mobs with different abilities and complete them with friends. Soon.

No lag. Unique gameplay. One network.

👉 Join now: nill.one or nillone.net or nillone.com
